## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Docs And Drift Checklist

- [ ] Did you change API routes or route behavior?
- [ ] Did you change provider defaults, model identifiers, or Bedrock candidate resolution behavior?
- [ ] Did you change upload, download, PDF, or email delivery behavior?
- [ ] Did you change risk routing or required-tool execution rules?
- [ ] If any answer above is yes, did you update `ARCHITECTURE.md`?
- [ ] If any answer above is yes, did you keep `README.md` high-level instead of duplicating volatile technical facts?
